section_summary: This section begins the Bank of Japan’s March 1947 Financial Statistics Monthly. It contains charts and tables on bank deposits, loans, securities, insurance, savings, stock trading, and Tokyo prices, with most series running through January 1947. The bulletin continues beyond page 33.

subfiles.title: Financial Statistics Monthly, March 1947
subfiles.about: Monthly statistical tables survey Japanese financial institutions, securities markets, savings, and prices.
subfiles.summary: The bulletin opens with charts, a contents page, and Bank of Japan balance sheet figures. Subsequent tables report deposits, lending, and securities holdings across banks, cooperatives, insurers, and savings institutions, generally through January 1947. The closing pages in this section cover securities trading, cleared bills in Tokyo and Osaka, and Tokyo wholesale and retail price indexes.
